test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 01 Dec, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/90b434b8817df53b771e13211cfd9da606570c5165826e58db10340b6519ce45.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) First box series →

The first column and 2nd row elements shift clockwise subsequently.

The rest of the elements clockwise subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c1d75c97caaf868414733ea24987b4af0b1a7eaedaa3483e6c1cfe188a9a374c.png] 

2) Second box series →

The first two row elements interchange positions diagonally.

The bottom row elements shift clockwise subsequently. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f354d9deee9563e58ed16428897ae92d7f2c81e77049c9eaa79eef0652b9cb94.png] 

 

Thus, the final series is: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5873da432372ef356c6d9a43a7707f053f26e22f20138b1c693e6a4307e5022e.png] 

 

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d320f542ab49ba5f40147ed9afb53168035e4e7bd2a63744821eb809577a338c.png]
